name: Le Meridien New Orleans
positioning: Le Méridien New Orleans: a downtown hotel on Poydras Street with a rooftop pool and a design that blends European heritage with contemporary style
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown New Orleans base near the French Quarter and the Arts District
Couples who want a suite with city and river views

facts.text: The hotel is on Poydras Street in the heart of downtown New Orleans.
The hotel is in a quiet area near the French Quarter and the Arts District.
The hotel's design blends European heritage with contemporary style.
The hotel has an outdoor rooftop pool.
Rooms and suites feature plush bedding, chic furnishings and destination-inspired artwork.
Guest rooms have plush pillowtop bedding.
Rooms have bathrobes and bath products from Malin + Goetz.
The hotel's meeting rooms include a garden and an art gallery.
The hotel has a 24-hour fitness center.
The hotel offers all-day dining overlooking Lafayette Square.
Longitude 90 serves Louisiana-inspired cuisine and handcrafted cocktails.

highlights.text: Guests can relax at the hotel's outdoor rooftop pool.
Some corner suites have city and river views.
The one-bedroom Executive Suite offers scenic views and expansive living areas.
The hotel's suites offer sweeping downtown views.

considerations.text: Rooms do not have a fridge.
Rollaway beds are not permitted in the rooms.
The minimum age to check in is 21.
